metrics.label: Avg ADR
metrics.def: Damage to enemies (capped at remaining HP) per round. Weapon filter: damage with that weapon per round in which the player had it.

metrics.label: Avg KPR
metrics.def: Enemy kills per round (weapon filter: kills with it per round with it).

metrics.label: Avg KDR
metrics.def: Kills / deaths. Weapon filter: kills with it / deaths while holding it. Ranked on kills / (kills + deaths).

metrics.label: HS%
metrics.def: Share of enemy kills that were headshots.

metrics.label: KAST
metrics.def: Rounds with a kill, assist, survival or traded death (all weapons). Ranked only where a between-player spread survives the Elo adjustment.

metrics.label: Avg Rating
metrics.def: Our HLTV-2.0-style rating, pooled over the selected rounds (the round-weighted average of match ratings).

metrics.label: Round Swing %
metrics.def: Round win probability added per round: each kill, death, plant, defuse and explosion moves the team's chance of winning the round (our round-state model); the change is credited to the players involved and summed, per round played.

metrics.label: Duel Success Rate
metrics.def: Share of decisive one-on-one fights won. Weapon filter = the weapon in the player's hand during the fight.

metrics.label: Sight-to-Shot (ms)
metrics.def: Clean sightings: from first seeing an opponent to the first shot at them, capped at 1 s and averaged.

metrics.label: Time-to-Damage (ms)
metrics.def: Clean sightings: from first seeing an opponent to the first damage dealt to them, clipped at 1.5 s, mean. Sightings without damage are excluded, so read it next to first-shot accuracy.

metrics.label: Counter-Strafe Rate
metrics.def: Burst-start shots fired at <= 34% of the weapon's max speed (scoped max for scoped weapons).

metrics.label: Counter-Strafed First-Shot Accuracy
metrics.def: Hit rate of counter-strafed burst-start shots.

metrics.label: First-Shot Accuracy
metrics.def: Hit rate of all burst-start shots.

metrics.label: Avg Flick Size (deg)
metrics.def: Clean sightings: angle between the crosshair at the sighting and at the first shot at the opponent (spray continuation excluded), clipped at 90 deg. Descriptive, not ranked.

metrics.label: Utility Wasted ($/Death)
metrics.def: Value of grenades still held at death, per death (all weapons).

metrics.label: First-Shot Accuracy While Moving
metrics.def: Hit rate of burst-start shots fired above the counter-strafe speed (compare with counter-strafed first-shot accuracy).

metrics.label: Duel Win % (First Shot Stopped)
metrics.def: Decisive fights in which the player's first shot at the opponent was counter-strafed. Fights where the player never shot at the opponent are in neither group.

metrics.label: Duel Win % (First Shot Moving)
metrics.def: Decisive fights in which the player's first shot at the opponent was fired while moving. Descriptive: moving shots cluster in close, already-joined fights.

metrics.label: Crosshair Placement Error (deg)
metrics.def: Clean sightings: angle from the crosshair to the enemy's head at the moment the enemy becomes visible, capped at 30 deg and averaged.

metrics.label: Duels Won After Hitting First
metrics.def: Decisive fights in which the player landed the first damage: share of those fights won (losses here point to spray and follow-up control).

metrics.label: Bullets per Kill
metrics.def: Kill-weapon shots from the start of the shot group that landed the first hit of the fatal exchange (after the previous kill) to the kill. Ranked per weapon filter only (AWP ~1 by construction).

metrics.label: Time-to-Kill (ms)
metrics.def: Time from the first hit with the kill weapon in the final burst to the kill, averaged; 0 = one-shot. Ranked only under the AWP or Rifle filter.

metrics.label: Damage per Spray
metrics.def: Enemy damage per spray of 6+ bullets. Ranked only under the AWP or Rifle filter.

metrics.label: Long-Spray Kill Rate
metrics.def: Share of 6+ bullet sprays that killed their target. A group that kills early ends as a tap / burst, so this measures finishing a target that survived the first 5 bullets. Ranked only under the AWP or Rifle filter.

metrics.label: Tap Accuracy
metrics.def: Share of single-shot taps that hit an enemy. Ranked only under the AWP or Rifle filter.

metrics.label: Deaths While Reloading
metrics.def: Share of deaths with the active weapon mid-reload (weapon filter = weapon held at death).

metrics.label: Deaths Mid Weapon-Switch
metrics.def: Share of deaths within 0.75 s of drawing / switching a weapon.

metrics.label: Deaths While Blind
metrics.def: Share of deaths while flashed by the killer's team.

metrics.label: Deaths to an Unchecked Angle
metrics.def: Share of deaths where the killer was off-screen when the killer started damaging the player.

metrics.label: Deaths While Running (Audible)
metrics.def: Share of deaths while making footsteps (footstep within 1 s or speed > 135 u/s).

metrics.label: Deaths with Utility Unused
metrics.def: Share of deaths still holding at least one grenade.

metrics.label: Deaths Traded Within 3 s
metrics.def: Share of deaths where a teammate killed the killer within 3 s.

metrics.label: Deaths Traded Within 5 s
metrics.def: Share of deaths traded within 5 s (the pipeline's standard trade window).

metrics.label: Untraded Opening Deaths
metrics.def: Share of the player's opening deaths (first death of the round) not traded within 5 s. Rounds with an untraded opening death are won far less often (see Maps); part of that gap is mechanical, since a trade restores the man count.

metrics.label: Nearest Teammate at Death (u)
metrics.def: Distance to the nearest alive teammate when the player died, mean. Descriptive (roles differ).

metrics.label: Trade Kills per 100 Rounds
metrics.def: Kills that avenged a teammate killed within the previous 5 s, per 100 rounds.

metrics.label: Low-HP Escapes (Share of Finishing Chances)
metrics.def: Gun exchanges that left the enemy alive below 30 HP and not finished by a teammate within 2 s, as a share of those escapes plus the player's gun kills.

metrics.label: Low-HP Escapes Who Then Got a Kill
metrics.def: Share of those escaped low-HP enemies who went on to kill someone on the player's team that round.

metrics.label: Enemy Blind Time per Flash (s)
metrics.def: Total enemy blind seconds per flash thrown.

metrics.label: Teammate Blind Time per Flash (s)
metrics.def: Total teammate blind seconds per flash thrown.

metrics.label: Kills off Own Flashes per 100 Flashes
metrics.def: Enemy kills on a victim blinded by the player's flash, per 100 flashes.

metrics.label: Damage per HE
metrics.def: Enemy damage per HE grenade.

metrics.label: Damage per Molotov
metrics.def: Enemy damage per molotov / incendiary.

metrics.label: Duel Win % vs Higher-Elo Opponents
metrics.def: Decisive fights against an opponent 50+ Elo above the player.

metrics.label: Duel Win % vs Lower-Elo Opponents
metrics.def: Decisive fights against an opponent 50+ Elo below the player.

metrics.label: Spray Hits vs Expected (Bullets 4+, pts)
metrics.def: Hit rate on bullets 4+ of a burst at a visible enemy, minus the lobby rate for the same weapon, bullet number, distance and moving / stopped (percentage points). Automatic weapons; Rifle = AK-47, M4A4, M4A1-S.

metrics.label: Spray Hit Rate (Bullets 4+)
metrics.def: Share of bullets 4+ at a visible enemy that hit. Raw: depends on range and weapon (see the expected-adjusted stat).

metrics.label: Follow-Up Hits vs Expected (Bullets 2-3, pts)
metrics.def: Bullets 2-3 of a burst: hit rate minus the lobby rate for the same weapon, bullet, distance and movement (percentage points).

metrics.label: Vertical Spray Drift (deg)
metrics.def: Bullets 4-12 of bursts that started on target: how far the aim moved above / below the enemy's chest since bullet 1, mean absolute degrees. Catches both under-pulling (rising) and over-pulling (dropping).

metrics.label: Horizontal Spray Drift (deg)
metrics.def: Bullets 4-12: how far the aim moved left / right of the enemy's chest since bullet 1, mean absolute degrees (includes the enemy strafing).

metrics.label: Spraying While Moving
metrics.def: Share of bullets 2+ fired above 34% of the weapon's max speed. Moving bullets hit about 20 points less often.

metrics.label: Crouch Spraying
metrics.def: Share of bullets 4+ fired crouched. Descriptive: crouched sprays hit more often, but crouching is also a positioning choice.

metrics.label: Re-Bursts Before Recoil Reset
metrics.def: Bursts started within 1 s of the previous one with the recoil index still at 2+ (two bullets of kick left). Those first bullets hit clearly less often.

metrics.label: Spray Transfer Success
metrics.def: Mid-spray switches to a second visible enemy that hit the new target within 3 bullets.

archetypes.The Carry: Highest statistics and the biggest swings toward winning rounds (Overall 50%, Round Swing % 30%, ADR 20%).
archetypes.Mr. Impact: Swings rounds toward winning, including beyond what his stats predict: Round Swing %, Round Swing above what his Overall predicts, clutching, pistols, knife rounds.
archetypes.The Backpack: Lowest individual statistics and impact (negative Overall, multi-kills, opening duels, clutching).
archetypes.The Glue Guy: Best support, trading and utility (equal thirds).
archetypes.Mr. Average: Very little special: category scores closest to the population average (lowest RMS z).
archetypes.The Anchor: The opposite of Mr. Impact: swings rounds toward losing, including beyond what his stats predict: low Round Swing %, Round Swing below what his Overall predicts, weak clutching, pistols and knife rounds.
archetypes.The Leprechaun: Very lucky: Luck rating, kills through smoke, grenade kills, flick wins.
archetypes.The Ninja: Lurker: distance from team, Lurker role, duel wins from behind, kills through smoke.
archetypes.The Tank: High entry rate, first in, lots of damage taken, dies first a lot.
archetypes.Master Angler: Deaths rarely traded, often last alive, lurks, trades off teammates (baits), lower impact.

Consistency: Matches With a Dud Round Swing
